summary.zh-CN: 从可检验问题到有证据的稿件、投稿包及返修；研究结论和施工验收分开。
summary.en: From testable questions to evidence-backed manuscripts, local submission packages, and revision; separate scientific support from construction acceptance.

inputs.zh-CN: 兴趣、观察、授权方向、期限与资源。
inputs.en: Interests, observations, authorized direction, deadline, and resources.

outputs.zh-CN: 问题卡、近似研究、可反驳预测和可行性。
outputs.en: Question card, nearest prior work, falsifiable predictions, and feasibility.

acceptance.zh-CN: 对象、比较、结果和反证可说清；未知保持未知。
acceptance.en: Object, comparison, outcome, and counterevidence are clear; unknowns remain unknown.

continue_when.zh-CN: 问题有边界，下一次查证目标已定。
continue_when.en: The question is bounded and the next evidence check is specified.

inputs.zh-CN: 明确问题、检索范围、已获准文献。
inputs.en: Defined question, search boundary, and authorized literature.

outputs.zh-CN: 检索日志、比较表、论断—来源—原文位置表。
outputs.en: Search log, comparison table, and claim-source-location ledger.

acceptance.zh-CN: 引用身份与支持关系分别核，反证和缺全文可见。
acceptance.en: Check citation identity separately from support; expose counterevidence and missing full text.

continue_when.zh-CN: 关键证据已核，或缩小论断后可以制定验证方案。
continue_when.en: Key evidence is checked, or claims are narrowed enough to design validation.

inputs.zh-CN: 论断、证据表、数据权利、基线和预算。
inputs.en: Claims, evidence ledger, data rights, baselines, and budget.

outputs.zh-CN: 划分/评价方案、论断—实验矩阵和运行顺序。
outputs.en: Split/evaluation protocol, claim-experiment matrix, and run order.

acceptance.zh-CN: 测试不用于选择，独立单位和公平预算明确。
acceptance.en: Test data does not select methods; independent units and fair budgets are explicit.

continue_when.zh-CN: 最小检查获准且输入资源齐全。
continue_when.en: A minimal check is authorized and its inputs/resources are ready.

inputs.zh-CN: 已定方案、代码版本、合法输入和运行预算。
inputs.en: Agreed protocol, code version, lawful inputs, and run budget.

outputs.zh-CN: 独立运行目录、原始结果、日志、失败与复跑命令。
outputs.en: Separate run folders, raw results, logs, failures, and rerun commands.

acceptance.zh-CN: 状态和次数来自真实日志；检查与正式运行分开。
acceptance.en: Status/counts come from actual logs; separate checks from formal runs.

continue_when.zh-CN: 运行结束且输出可追溯；失败先核原因或交缺口。
continue_when.en: Runs ended with traceable output; diagnose failure or hand off its gap first.

inputs.zh-CN: 原始结果、方案、评价版本及成功失败记录。
inputs.en: Raw outputs, protocol, evaluation version, and successes/failures.

outputs.zh-CN: 可复算结果表、图表、统计说明和论断证据。
outputs.en: Recalculable tables, figures, statistical notes, and claim evidence.

acceptance.zh-CN: 每个数字可回到运行；误差、分母和局限明确。
acceptance.en: Every number traces to a run; uncertainty, denominators, and limitations are explicit.

continue_when.zh-CN: 论断范围有据，可进入写作；不足则预算内补查。
continue_when.en: Claim scope is supported for writing; otherwise check further within budget.

inputs.zh-CN: 真实方法结果、证据表、引用库和文体要求。
inputs.en: Actual methods/results, evidence table, citations, and writing requirements.

outputs.zh-CN: 稿件、预览、引用及一致性核验、作者声明缺口。
outputs.en: Manuscript, preview, citation/consistency checks, and author-statement gaps.

acceptance.zh-CN: 无虚构数字或批准；正文表图引用互相一致。
acceptance.en: No fabricated numbers/approval; prose, figures, tables, and citations agree.

continue_when.zh-CN: 证据与预览检查通过，目标期刊准备输入齐全。
continue_when.en: Evidence/preview checks pass and target-venue preparation inputs are ready.

inputs.zh-CN: 目标期刊、当前官方指南、定稿与真实作者信息。
inputs.en: Target venue, current official guidelines, final draft, and actual author details.

outputs.zh-CN: 本地投稿包、官方要求对照及待作者确认项。
outputs.en: Local submission package, official-requirement map, and author confirmations.

acceptance.zh-CN: 文件实际打开；准备好和已提交严格区分。
acceptance.en: Actually open files; distinguish prepared from submitted.

continue_when.zh-CN: 作者确认后交其授权操作者；本技能不上传发布。
continue_when.en: After author confirmation, hand off to their authorized operator; this skill does not upload/publish.

inputs.zh-CN: 本人稿件的审稿意见、提交版本、期限和预算。
inputs.en: Reviews of this manuscript, submitted version, deadline, and budget.

outputs.zh-CN: 原意见、返修矩阵、新稿、证据和回复草稿。
outputs.en: Original comments, revision matrix, new draft, evidence, and response draft.

acceptance.zh-CN: 每条意见有真实回应与新稿位置；未解决明确。
acceptance.en: Each comment has a real response/location; unresolved issues are explicit.

continue_when.zh-CN: 作者确认，材料齐全再交授权提交者。
continue_when.en: With author confirmation and complete materials, hand off to the authorized submitter.

inputs.zh-CN: 已核论文、观众、讲述时间及授权材料。
inputs.en: Verified paper, audience, allotted time, and authorized materials.

outputs.zh-CN: 单一主线讲稿、幻灯片、计时排练和问题清单。
outputs.en: Focused talk, slides, timed rehearsal, and question list.

acceptance.zh-CN: 证据和图表同稿一致，演讲时长真测。
acceptance.en: Evidence/figures match the manuscript and duration is actually rehearsed.

continue_when.zh-CN: 交作者确认后用于其安排的汇报，不自行传播。
continue_when.en: Use for the author-arranged presentation after confirmation; do not distribute independently.

summary.zh-CN: 受众与目的 → 逐页计划 → 可编辑制作 → 视觉检查 → 文件打开 → 计时和交付；科学结果仍按证据。
summary.en: Audience/purpose → slide plan → editable production → visual review → file opening → timing/delivery; scientific findings remain evidence-grounded.

outputs.zh-CN: 沟通约定、输入模式与缺口
outputs.en: Communication contract, input mode and gaps

acceptance.zh-CN: 用途、事实、权利及可编辑要求明确
acceptance.en: Purpose, facts, rights and editability are explicit

continue_when.en: Continue the next authorized task after checking current artifacts/inputs

inputs.zh-CN: 沟通约定、真实来源和时间预算
inputs.en: Communication contract, actual sources and time budget

outputs.zh-CN: 逐页任务、论断图表和备注

acceptance.zh-CN: 每页有作用，图表能回源
acceptance.en: Every page has a purpose and traceable figures

continue_when.zh-CN: 当前产物及输入核实后推进下一件获准任务
continue_when.en: Continue the next authorized task after checking current artifacts/inputs

inputs.zh-CN: 确认计划、素材和实际制作工具
inputs.en: Agreed plan, assets and actual tools

continue_when.zh-CN: 当前产物及输入核实后推进下一件获准任务
continue_when.en: Continue the next authorized task after checking current artifacts/inputs

inputs.zh-CN: 实际逐页预览、源数据和目标格式
inputs.en: Actual previews, source data and target format

outputs.zh-CN: 问题修复、打开检查和差异

acceptance.zh-CN: 全部页真看，最终文件真开
acceptance.en: Actually view pages and open final files

continue_when.zh-CN: 当前产物及输入核实后推进下一件获准任务
continue_when.en: Continue the next authorized task after checking current artifacts/inputs

acceptance.en: Actual rehearsal and explicit unverified items
